sec: sec:C012: Third-party testing for customer-defined risk

blocks.id: blk:C012: Third-party testing for customer-defined risk/1
blocks.text: Appoint expert third-parties to evaluate system robustness to additional high-risk outputs as defined in risk taxonomy at least every 3 months.
